vetSays.line: A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +2 clean.
"You haven't earned that yet," A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm says. (Trust too low.)

You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling A person, maybe 60s, with a slouched posture about A man, maybe 40s, with tattooed arms. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 40s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Kayden, Elías, Qiang, Chloe and Zoe met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Kayden, Elías, Qiang are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Kayden just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elías just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Kayden, Elías and Chloe met them at the door — 2 put down. Chloe didn't come back. Kayden is hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Simon just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Debbie, Kayden, Simon, Henry and Makiling met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Debbie, Kayden, Simon, Henry, Makiling are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
